hook_events.title: Research workspace created
hook_events.description: A fresh git-versioned workspace was initialised for an experiment kind and its initial commit made, so the autoresearch loop (read -> edit -> run -> keep/reset) can begin against it. Fires once per POST /api/research/workspace, whether the desktop or an agent asked for it. It says a workspace EXISTS, not that anything has been run in it — the attempts themselves go through the research.* MCP tools inside Core and are not visible here. `mutable_files` is the set of files a researcher is allowed to edit; the researcher instructions (program_md) are deliberately left out of the payload because they are a document, not a signal.
